correctness.rationale: For n>=3 the unsigned K_n edge-incidence B has full row rank over characteristic 3. A=B^T B+I and BB^T=(n-2)I+J with J^2=nJ. Rank C^r=rank(BB^T)^{r-1} gives exact length-one/two Jordan blocks in all three n mod3 classes, including n=3. A block J_s(2) or J_s(1) lifts under (u,v)->(Au-v,u) to J_{2s}(1) or J_{2s}(-1), while adjacency eigenvalue 0 yields an order-four two-dimensional block. Frobenius gives fixed dimensions min(2s,3^{nu3(t)}), restricted to divisible-by-2 time for eigenvalue -1; order-four blocks contribute two if 4|t. This proves the all-time displayed E_n(t), global orders 9/18/36, and period populations by Mobius inversion. An independently written exact mod3 matrix implementation checked ALL 1<=t<=L_n and n=3..8 with predicted nullities.
